title: Codex CLI upgrade and switch to Sol 6.2 on Central, DL560 and Mac (Greg): plan, compatibility probe, rollback, one restart window
outcome: TermAl's Codex sessions on Central, DL560 and Mac run the current Codex CLI and use Sol 6.2 by its exact model id. The switch has a tested rollback and happens in one agreed restart window, without stopping work early.
acceptance: Facts recorded per host (Central, DL560, Mac), read-only: the `codex` TermAl resolves on PATH, its version, the latest published version, and the exact Sol 6.2 model id as reported by `model/list` of the new CLI.

A compatibility probe in a repo-local install (.tmp, no global install) shows that TermAl's app-server contract still works with the new CLI: thread start, turn, approvals and model/list, or names any break.

One plan, sent to Greg in Polish, gives: the upgrade and model-switch steps per host, the rollback (pin back to the old version), the one restart window, and exactly which steps need Greg's action and which agents can do.
